_notes: Castle battle (docs/specs/SPEC-castle-battle.md). grid: board size in tiles [w, h]. path: one axis-aligned polyline in tiles through tile centres, from the left castle (side 0) to the right castle (side 1); both sides walk it in opposite directions. Distances on the path are measured from side 0's castle; side 1 uses length - d. forts.atPct: fort positions as % of path length. summonBasePct: how far (% of path) a side may summon before it holds a fort; summonGapTiles: the summon zone also stops this far short of the nearest enemy unit, but never short of homeZoneTiles: the castle gate (0 to homeZoneTiles from our castle) is always open, even with enemies on it. mana: startPvp (a ranked/league 1v1 match starts with this much; PvE stages set their own later), max (the bank cannot hold more), regenSec is one point every everySec while the match clock is in [fromSec, toSec). sizes: mana cost band [min, max] per size and perMatch = times EACH card of that size may be summoned in one match (null = unlimited). moves: walking speed in tiles/s per move role, its Thai name and what it does (card text). meleeRange: range in tiles of units whose range is 0 or below it. supportHeal: HP a support unit heals per hit on the most-hurt ally in range; supportGapTiles: how far it stays behind the front ally. critPct: chance a metal-kit unit hits for double. Unit on-hit kit (sects.json roster.units, all optional): splash (tiles: the hit also lands on every enemy it can hit this close to the target), slowSec (walks status.slowPct % slower), rootSec (cannot walk, still fights), stunSec (does nothing), pushTiles (knocked back toward its own castle; never a large unit), groundSec (burning ground of radius status.groundRadius at what it hits; a flier also drops it where it flies, once per cooldown), armor (flat damage taken off every hit, at least 1 gets through), pierce (ignores armor). Every unit has tagTh (one-line Thai role and what it counters) and counters (keys of counterTags). sectDecks: the preset 8-card deck of each sect, its own cards only. dot: burn and poison (fire-sect / wood-sect units), ticking every 0.5 s. fort: hp, dmg per shot, rate shots/s, range and captureRadius in tiles, captureSec = time a capture unit must hold a neutral fort with no enemy on it. castle: same shape; art = the castle's one-per-match bell (stuns every enemy in our half of the path for stunSec). matchSec: match length; ties are broken in spec section 7 order.
